items.t: Whistle, squeal and rough idle from a cracked camshaft cover
items.job: Replace engine camshaft cover with built-in PCV valve
items.note: Free on cars covered by GM special coverage. Owners without coverage report paying $1,800-$2,300 at dealers.

items.t: Rear window separating from the convertible top
items.job: Replace convertible top cover with rear glass
items.note: Owners report quotes of $3,000-$5,000. Re-gluing the glass is cheaper but often does not last.

items.t: Loss of power from turbocharger failure
items.job: Replace turbocharger

items.t: No crank or no start with the security light on
items.job: Diagnose immobilizer and reprogram or replace module

items.t: Engine cranks by itself and then won't start
items.job: Diagnose starting circuit and replace faulty relay, switch or module

items.t: Misfire, rough running and check engine light
items.job: Replace spark plugs or ignition coil, or clean fuel injectors

items.t: Steam from the grille area
items.job: Cooling system pressure test and inspection

items.t: Water sloshing inside the rear quarter panel
items.job: Clear and repair quarter panel drains

items.t: Windows move up or down on their own
items.job: Diagnose window control, reprogram or replace roof control module

items.t: Windows close automatically with the roof (recall)
items.job: Replace convertible roof control module (recall 16V844000)

items.t: Convertible top won't open or close
items.job: Adjust cargo shade partition or diagnose power top

items.t: Holes wearing through the soft top near the rear
items.job: Replace convertible top cover

items.t: Battery goes dead after short drives
items.job: Replace tail lamps and test battery

items.t: Low oil pressure warning
items.job: Test oil pressure and replace oil pressure sensor

items.t: Power loss in very cold weather
items.job: Inspect intake for icing and apply bulletin update

items.t: Black smoke at startup after sitting
items.job: Diagnose fuel injectors and apply bulletin repair

items.t: A/C blows warm air
items.job: A/C leak test and recharge, or replace failed part

items.t: Radio goes blank or shows Theft Locked
items.job: Radio software update or unlock

items.t: Bluetooth, voice control or OnStar not working
items.job: Radio or OnStar module software update

items.t: Seat belt presenter arm noisy or not working
items.job: Replace seat belt presenter motor

items.t: Passenger shoulder belt knocks in the wind
items.job: Reposition passenger shoulder belt

items.t: Side mirror glass shakes at speed
items.job: Repair or replace side mirror glass

items.t: Red brake warning light flickers on
items.job: Brake inspection and fluid level check

items.t: Alarm goes off by itself
items.job: Diagnose alarm and replace faulty latch switch
